about.heading: About Brannigan Heating & Air Conditioning
body: Ed Brannigan founded Brannigan Heating & Air Conditioning in 1987 out of a single truck and his garage on the north end of Springfield. Nearly forty years later the company runs eight trucks and employs fourteen people, but the approach has not changed: do good work, charge a fair price, and treat every house like it belongs to your own family.

Brannigan Heating & Air Conditioning has been keeping Springfield families comfortable since 1987. We are a family owned and operated HVAC contractor serving Springfield, Chatham, Rochester and the surrounding communities. Our technicians are NATE certified and we service all makes and models of heating and cooling equipment.

We are fully licensed and insured in the state of Illinois, and every technician on staff carries NATE certification. We are also an accredited business with the Better Business Bureau and have held an A+ rating since 2004.
We pride ourselves on honest pricing, clean work and showing up when we say we will. No high pressure sales, no surprise charges, and every job is backed by our satisfaction guarantee.

services.name: Air Conditioning Repair
services.summary: Fast diagnosis and repair for every major brand of central air conditioner. Most repairs completed same day, and we stock the common parts on every truck.

services.name: Furnace Repair & Replacement
services.summary: From emergency no-heat calls to planned high-efficiency furnace replacement, with financing available on new equipment.

services.name: Heat Pump Installation
services.summary: Energy efficient heat pump systems sized correctly for your home, including ductless mini split installation.

services.name: Preventive Maintenance Plans
services.summary: Twice yearly tune ups that keep your equipment under warranty and catch small problems before they become expensive ones.

services.name: Indoor Air Quality
services.summary: Whole home humidifiers, air purifiers, UV lamps and duct cleaning to help with allergies and dust.

services.name: Commercial HVAC
services.summary: Rooftop units, service contracts and planned replacement for small commercial buildings in the Springfield area.

faqs.question: Do you offer emergency service?
faqs.answer: Yes. We answer the phone 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including holidays. Emergency calls are dispatched to an on-call technician immediately.

faqs.question: How often should I have my furnace serviced?
faqs.answer: We recommend a professional tune up once a year, ideally in early fall before the first cold snap. Air conditioners should be serviced each spring.

faqs.question: Do you offer financing on new equipment?
faqs.answer: We do. We offer approved credit financing with terms up to sixty months on qualifying new system installations.

faqs.question: What brands do you service?
faqs.answer: All of them. Our technicians are factory trained on Carrier, Trane, Lennox, Goodman, Rheem and American Standard equipment.
